-- Check one of the tied matches
WITH ball_runs AS (SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.striker, CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.striker ELSE b.non_striker END AS p1, CASE WHEN b.striker < b.non_striker THEN b.non_striker ELSE b.striker END AS p2, bs.runs_scored AS rs FROM ball_by_ball b JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no), partnership AS (SELECT match_id, innings_no, p1, p2, SUM(rs) AS partnership_runs FROM ball_runs GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, p1, p2), max_partnership AS (SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) AS max_runs FROM partnership GROUP BY match_id), best_pairs AS (SELECT p.match_id, p.p1, p.p2, p.partnership_runs FROM partnership p JOIN max_partnership m ON p.match_id = m.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = m.max_runs), player_scores AS (SELECT match_id, striker AS player_id, SUM(rs) AS individual_score FROM ball_runs GROUP BY match_id, striker) SELECT bp.match_id, bp.p1, bp.p2, bp.partnership_runs, COALESCE(ps1.individual_score, 0) AS score1, COALESCE(ps2.individual_score, 0) AS score2 FROM best_pairs bp LEFT JOIN player_scores ps1 ON bp.match_id = ps1.match_id AND bp.p1 = ps1.player_id LEFT JOIN player_scores ps2 ON bp.match_id = ps2.match_id AND bp.p2 = ps2.player_id WHERE bp.match_id = 729312
